visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an expansive view of a mountain slope densely covered in orange daylily flowers. A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a colorful orange floral skirt, dances and spins joyfully in the middle of the field. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, creating a vibrant atmosphere. (2) At Chike Mountain, the woman is seen walking along a narrow dirt path with a man wearing a blue shirt and a sun hat. They are surrounded by rolling hills of orange flowers. Close-up shots show the woman's excited facial expression and hand gestures as she points at the scenery. Aerial drone shots reveal the vast scale of the golden flower blankets across the green landscape. (3) The scene transitions to Taimali, where the woman walks up a brick staircase flanked by tall orange blossoms. She sits at a wooden table on an outdoor deck, holding a skewer of deep-fried daylilies. She smiles and takes a large bite, gesturing with her hands to show how delicious it is. The background shows distant green mountains under a blue sky with soft clouds. (4) Finally, at Liushishi Mountain, the couple is shown sitting together among the flowers, looking at a digital tablet. The woman wears a red crop top and denim shorts, pointing towards the horizon. The video concludes with a fast-paced montage of scenic overlooks and the couple waving at the camera from the flower-covered hills during the warm golden hour.
